title: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco Shortfill balances earthy Tobacco with the fruity sharpness of ripe Cherry for a distinctive flavour combination. The Tobacco provides depth and body, while Cherry brightens the profile with sweet yet tangy notes. Together they create a satisfying blend that’s both traditional and unique. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this 100ml shortfill is designed for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits and high-powered devices, producing dense vapour and rounded flavour. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots to tailor your preferred strength. Made in the UK, Vampire Vape are respected for their inventive recipes and consistent quality, and their Tobacco collection demonstrates how classic bases can be enhanced with distinctive accents.
